newsitem.title: MEXICO: Televisa, Medcom link up for DTH TV.
newsitem.headline: Televisa, Medcom link up for DTH TV.

text.p: Mexico's Grupo Televisa said on Tuesday it had reached an agreement in principle with Mexico's Grupo Medcom to jointly transmit Direct to Home (DTH) television services in Mexico and the United States.

"Grupo Medcom and Grupo Televisa announced today that they have reached agreement in principle to unite their efforts related to their projects for transmission of DTH television service in Mexican and U.S. territory," Televisa said in a statement.
It gave no further details of the accord.
